environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to ALB with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY overridden to COUNT, all others BLOCK; (2) A custom rule group 'corp-input-sanitization-rg' with priority 0 containing a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request body and query string against pattern `(?i)(?:'+|'\s*(?:OR|AND|UNION|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|ALTER|EXEC|HAVING|ORDER\s+BY|GROUP\s+BY))` with action BLOCK and TextTransformation URL_DECODE applied before matching. CloudWatch alarm on WAF BlockedRequests metric with SNS notification. Additionally, ALB has a listener rule that routes /api/reports/* to a fixed-response 403 unless the request contains header X-Internal-Caller with value matching a Secrets Manager rotated token validated by a Lambda@Edge authorizer.
